name: Qwen
why: Qwen models are generally the best if you want local models in the 100b max size.

quotes.quote: Qwen models are generally the best if you want local models in the 100b max size.
quotes.excerpt: Qwen models are generally the best if you want local models in the 100b max size. I am not sure but I recommend looking at the size of deepseek flash as well to see if it can work for you, perhaps GLM 5 Air model is also around this size. and if you want something at the larger models scale, then you have glm 5.2, kimi k2.7,mimo v2.5 pro and deepseek v4
